title: The Calabi flow with prescribed curvature on finite graphs
summary: In this paper, we investigate the prescribed curvature problem associated with a special Lin-Lu-Yau curvature on finite graphs of girth at least 6. We define the corresponding Calabi flow for this curvature type, and establish an equivalent characterization of the problem, namely, the solution to the Calabi flow exists globally in time and converges if and only if there exists a weight function that realizes the prescribed curvature.
